services.desc: We love a good party here at Dogfish Head, which is why we’re pleased to offer an endless variety of experiences for weddings and special celebrations! With a knowledgeable team and an ability to think outside the box, we’re here to help you craft your perfect day. From bridal showers, rehearsal dinners and receptions, to birthday parties and corporate events, let’s get creative in bringing your special day to life. With four properties located across coastal Delaware, each offers their own unique look and feel.
